answer_sentences.text: Provided sources say a borrower may prepay a housing loan “either in part or in full, at any point during the residual tenor of the loan,” but they do not mention any foreclosure charge, so from these sources alone I cannot confirm whether UCB can levy one on a March 2026 floating-rate home loan.
answer_sentences.quote: “(c) To prepay, either in part or in full, at any point during the residual tenor of the loan.”
